line: Bitcoin drifting higher on neutral sentiment and warm funding, as whales accumulate on-exchange and stablecoins exit venues ahead of the FOMC conclusion tomorrow.
small_line: Written from Bitcoin +1.35% on the day, spot ETF net +110.3M USD (Oct 26, 2026), Fear & Greed 48 (neutral), funding +0.0100% per 8h (warm)

wire_top3.line: Ripple won OCC approval to operate a national trust bank backing its $2.6 billion RLUSD stablecoin, separating issuance from custody under federal oversight.
CFTC sued Utah to block state enforcement against prediction markets, asserting federal agency jurisdiction over a sector states are now targeting.
Intel, Oracle, IBM, and 23 other firms have now filed objections to OKX-ICE's tokenized stock trading venue, challenging the SEC's new framework.
